Subject: Onboarding: banking details and PO rules needed to start payments

Hi Lindsey,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off RidgeLine as a vendor. To finalize finance setup we need the items below so we can generate POs and route your ACH/wires correctly: 

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached is the template)
- W9 (pdf)
- ACH authorization or wire instructions (bank name, routing/ABA, account last 4) -- you can mask full account numbers in email and attach the authorization form
- Preferred remittance format (CSV, EDI, or email PDF) and a sample of invoice labeling (we use PO tags to route invoices into our AP flow)

A few requirements from our side: payments are issued against our PO numbers and we require invoices to include the PO exactly as encoded: PO:<PO_NUMBER> or PO-<PO_NUMBER> in the invoice filename and in the invoice body. If you prefer a different delimiter, let us know now so we can map it.

If you can return the W9 and ACH authorization, we will trigger a verification micro-deposit and confirm when the test posts. Also include the remit contact for invoice receipt (name & email).

I've attached the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf for you to fill. Once we have W9 + ACH auth we'll run the bank validation and reply with remittance format confirmation and PO encoding example.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we are targeting our first PO within two weeks.

Best,
Avery Johnson

Hi team,

Finance completed the preliminary bank verification this morning and we sent a $0.50 micro-deposit to the RIDGELINE account (should post within 24 hours on their side). Once RidgeLine confirms the amount we will flip the vendor to Active and the first PO can be issued.

For remittance ingestion, we can support both CSV SFTP and emailed PDFs. To make automated PO matching reliable we recommend the following:

- Filename convention: RIDGELINE_INV_PO-<PO_NUMBER>_<INVOICE_NUMBER>.pdf (or .csv)
- CSV required columns (order matters): po_number, invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), net_amount, remittance_note
- If RidgeLine will send CSV, include po_number exactly as digits (no PO: prefix). Our ingestion engine will accept the CSV po_number field and map it to the internal PO tag.

Example encoding for a PDF filename we will accept: RIDGELINE_INV_PO-123456_INV-7890.pdf

Once the micro-deposit is validated by RidgeLine, I will mark the vendor Active in our ERP and note the PO filename rules on their vendor record.

Marissa Cole
Finance Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
